arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_brand = 'Amex')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made with an American Express card, meaning any card whose brand is Amex, regardless of card type, amount, or transaction channel.
assumptions: 'American Express' is taken to mean card_brand = 'Amex', the value listed in the cards table.
The rule covers all Amex cards, including credit, debit and prepaid types, and all transaction types.
